title: Nifty 8/10: bull call spread 24700/24850 (9 Nov)
summary: Buy 24700 CE (~146), sell 24850 CE (~85) for ~61. Target 95–100, stop 40 or a 30-min close below 24600.
body_md:
Nifty at 24,684 (12:45 snapshot). **Score: 8/10.**

**Why**
- Call writers ran away from 24,600 and 24,650 (about 97,000 contracts closed in 30 minutes). That is the biggest unwinding today.
- Fresh put writing at 24,500, 24,650 and 24,700 (about 108,000 new contracts). 24,700 is turning from resistance into support.
- The learner's pattern "put writers stronger" has been followed by Nifty going up 91% of the time (26 cases).
- The 125-minute and 25-minute trends are both up. The weekly trend is still bearish, so not a 10.
- Nifty is up about 70 points from 24,615. The next call wall is at 24,850 to 24,900, so there is room left.

**Trade (hedged, recommended)**
Buy the 24,700 CE (about 146) and sell the 24,850 CE (about 85). Expiry 9 Nov.
- Net cost: about 61 points (enter if it is between 58 and 68). About ₹3,965 per lot (lot 65).
- Max profit: about 89 points (₹5,785 per lot) if Nifty is at 24,850 or above at expiry.
- Practical target today or Monday: exit when the spread is worth about 95 to 100 (Nifty near 24,800). About +35 points, or ₹2,300 to 2,500 per lot.
- Stop-loss: exit if the spread falls to 40, or if a 30-minute snapshot closes below 24,600. Loss about 21 points, or ₹1,365 per lot.
- Reward to risk is about 1.7 to 1.

**Alternative (naked buy):** buy the 24,700 CE at 140 to 150. Stop-loss 118 (about ₹1,800 loss per lot). Target 185 to 190 (about ₹2,600 to 2,800 profit per lot).

Skip it if Nifty is already above 24,760, because most of the move will be gone.

If you hold the neutral iron condor (24,500/24,800), its short 24,800 CE is now closer. Exit it if a snapshot closes above 24,800.

_Analysis only, not trading advice._
